reference.title: Equation of state and phase diagram of Fe–16Si alloy as a candidate component of Earth’s core

methods.notes: Exact Fischer 2012 B2 KBr thermal calibration is not bundled; do not substitute the Dewaele 2012 KBr record. KBr is colder than the sample; the marker temperature requires the source gradient correction.

reference.title: Calibration of the ruby pressure gauge to 800 kbar under quasi-hydrostatic conditions

methods.notes: Additional room-temperature pressure standard; no raw ruby wavelengths are tabulated.

recalculation.notes: Raw KBr lattice parameters are retained for all compressed observations. Only corrected sample temperatures are tabulated; marker temperatures would require reconstruction of the original surface-temperature/gradient procedure, not a second sample correction. Secondary ruby/neon raw readings are not tabulated.

pressure_calibration.notes: KBr is the principal pressure standard. Room-temperature compression uses neon medium and ruby as an additional standard; source tables do not include ruby wavelengths or per-row marker attribution. Zero uncertainties at the reference row do not define infinite fitting weight.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.
qualifications: Complete single-phase source rows with published fixed choices. Unweighted pressure residuals and residual-scaled refit errors are diagnostics: source weights, coefficient confidence and covariance are unspecified. Parity denotes the ledger's numerical/combined-error criterion, not recovery of the authors' regression covariance. The Fe-16Si entry checks the 66-row thermal stage; the independent script also refits its 32-row static stage. See the [Fischer audit](literature-reproductions/fischer-2014-fesi.md).

locations: 2014 official Table S1, source worksheet row numbers retained
primary_source_check.finding: Verified primary parameters and exact atomic-volume conversion, source-fixed choices, single-phase data selection and independent BM3/Vinet/MGD evaluation. Source coefficient errors are retained; diagnostic fitting weights are explicitly an audit assumption. See docs/literature-reproductions/fischer-2014-fesi.md.
primary_source_check.record_note: Coefficients from Table 1 and Section 4.1 with Equations (1)-(2); V0 is printed as 6.961 cm³/mol of atoms and converted to the 16-atom cell.

source_locations: 2014 official Table S1, source worksheet row numbers retained
primary_data_check.finding: All 211 rows and available coordinate errors/marker measurements are preserved. 15 D03 observations are selected for this branch. No mixed-phase observations are silently admitted.

scientific_validation.note: Verified primary parameters and exact atomic-volume conversion, source-fixed choices, single-phase data selection and independent BM3/Vinet/MGD evaluation. Source coefficient errors are retained; diagnostic fitting weights are explicitly an audit assumption. See docs/literature-reproductions/fischer-2014-fesi.md.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Table 1 and Section 4.1; 2014 official Table S1, source worksheet row numbers retained.
parameter_provenance.equation: Main equations (1)-(2); standard Vinet replaces BM3 for the alternatives according to Text S1. Thermal pressure is referenced to 300 K using the integrated-Gruneisen Debye-temperature law.
parameter_provenance.V0: Table 1 and Section 4.1: 6.961 cm^3/mol atoms; multiply by 16/0.602214076 for this cell. Measured and held fixed.
parameter_provenance.uncertainties: Source-reported errors; confidence convention and covariance unspecified. Measured V0 errors remain recorded even when V0 is fixed.
parameter_provenance.fit_protocol: Diagnostic refits use unweighted pressure residuals; the source does not publish the numerical objective/weights or covariance. Published coefficients remain unchanged.

superseded_record_text.notes: Diagnostic refits use unweighted pressure residuals; the source does not publish the numerical objective/weights or covariance. Published coefficients remain unchanged. BM3 is the source-preferred default; Vinet is a separately preserved published alternative. Room-temperature compression can retain metastable phases because of slow kinetics.
